stem: Which statement describes a result of this innovation?

options.label: A
options.text: It forced consumers to buy larger houses in order to make room for these appliances.

options.label: B
options.text: It decreased the need for consumers to clean their tableware after meals in restaurants.

options.label: C
options.text: It decreased the amount of time consumers spent completing household chores.

options.label: D
options.text: It forced consumers back to school in order to learn how to operate these appliances.
